# ApexAML

> Compliance Intelligence platform for Nigerian fintechs, banks and IMTOs. CBN-aligned AML controls — AI-assisted STR drafting from the case's own data, reviewed and edited by an analyst. BVN/NIN KYC, transaction monitoring with Nigerian typologies, and NFIU goAML reporting.

ApexAML is built specifically to satisfy the 10 capability areas mandated by CBN Circular BSD/DIR/PUB/LAB/019/002. Hosted on Supabase (AWS Ireland, eu-west-1), encrypted in transit and at rest. Data residency in Nigeria is not currently offered. Contact us about your requirements.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, pricing, FAQ and lead capture for Nigerian financial institutions.
- [CBN Roadmap Generator](/roadmap): Free tool that generates a CBN-compliant AML implementation roadmap, pre-formatted for Circular BSD/DIR/PUB/LAB/019/002.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How ApexAML collects, processes and stores personal data under the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023.

## Pricing

- Essential: ₦550,000/month.
- Starter: ₦1,100,000/month.
- Growth: ₦2,800,000/month.
- IMTO: ₦9 per transaction with a ₦3,500,000 monthly minimum.
- Professional Implementation Programme: from ₦1,500,000 to ₦12,000,000 depending on scope.

## Optional access

- [Sign in](/login): Restricted login for compliance officers at customer institutions.
